_readme: S663 SkyLark, 2026-11-16. Sam's ruling d-both-versions-by-catalog-year-sam-2026-11-15: a plain transfer degree and its 2.0 each keep a record from their own catalog year. Riverside City's four plain siblings (30578, 32692, 32745, 33829) read from their 2.0's page in catalog 124 (2026-2027). The prior-catalog read needs the 2025-2026 catalog's id and its alias view. This read asks the host's own catalog list, as cq_catalog_from_list reads it, and the active-catalogs page. Two loads, no model call. Run 43791837041 (S663): _getCatalogs lists only the active catalogs (Moreno Valley 115, Norco 116, Riverside City 124); _getActiveCatalogById/124 returns its Title. This pass asks _getActiveCatalogById for ids 100 to 123, one load each, to find the Riverside City 2025-2026 catalog. Run 43792698831 (S663): ids 100 to 123 return [] except 115 Moreno Valley 2026-2027 and 116 Norco 2026-2027; the endpoint serves active catalogs only, so curriQunet does not publish Riverside City's 2025-2026 catalog. This pass looks for an archived 2025-2026 catalog on the college's own site.

questions.prior_view: Where rcc.edu links its 2025-2026 catalog (an archive page or a PDF), and its address.
